about: For @mackygolfs. 14 shirt wipes back to back (1.1–2.1 s each), each from the natural start of the wipe through the reveal of your face, cut just before you start talking: orange checker (storm + dry field), green polo (San Angelo + sunny), white shirt/camo hat (x3), light blue print, black print/white hat (x3), blue striped polo in the rain. Opens on the orange-checker smile, ends on the black-print smile. Each clip keeps its own sound, evened out (-16 LUFS); no music, no added text, no speed effects. All cut from your true Dropbox originals. Preview copy here; the real file is full quality.
